description: This file implements an in-memory storage provider for Orleans grains, including methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, as well as serialization/deserialization logic and a factory for creating instances.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorage
classes.description: A class implementing an in-memory grain storage provider for Orleans, supporting read, write, and delete operations with serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: MemoryGrainStorage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the in-memory storage provider with configuration options, logger, grain factory, serializer, and activator provider.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state of a grain asynchronously from in-memory storage.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the state of a grain asynchronously to in-memory storage.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears the state of a grain asynchronously from in-memory storage.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes binary data into a grain state object.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes a grain state object into binary data.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a grain state object using the activator provider.

methods.name: GetStorageGrain
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate storage grain based on the hash of the key.

methods.name: MakeKey
methods.description: Generates a storage key from grain type and grain ID.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the storage provider (no implementation).
